rv.q: There was nothing I didn't love about this production.
This production is the model of sophisticated and frothy escapism at its best.
The result is a production that maintains the original's comedic momentum while arriving at a more earnest and resonant conclusion.
Everything about this touring production is smashing.
It Hot transforms a classic into a celebration of self and sensibility.
“It Hot” is full of razzle-dazzle, romance, and the tender journey of self-discovery, which all adds up to a great time at the theater.
This adaptation keeps you smiling and grooving to the rhythms throughout the show, as well as long after you leave the theatre.
It's classy, sassy, has a light and fun plot and top quality music and dance.
This show is entertainment at its finest leaving a toe-tapping song and a classic story in audiences hearts.
This adaptation not only maintains the spirit of the film but it expands upon it in every single delightful way.
From that point on, Act One motors along jauntily, but Act Two is when “Some Like It Hot” starts to elevate, almost levitate, and turns into something really special.

cn.t: Critics praise this dazzling, splashy touring production as sophisticated escapism with spectacular choreography and costumes. The show seamlessly weaves a modern, timely message about transgender identity into its classic story.
